full_judgment: A.T.M Afzal, CJ: Distraught parents of the children reading in one of the daycare centers in the city, Play Pen Kinder Care, have gone to the Court complaining about enhancement of various fees for 1997 by the Principal thereof, defendant-petitioner before us and sought for a mandatory decree not to raise the fees above those as in 1996. They also prayed for an order of temporary injunction and the learned Subordinate Judge, First Court, Dhaka by order dated 30. 11. 96 passed in Title Suit No. 303 of 1996 issued show cause notice upon the defendant-petitioner and directed her to maintain status quo in respect of realisation of fees from the children upto 8.1.97. Being aggrieved by the said order the petitioner came to the High Court Division in appeal and a Division Bench by the impugned order dated 14 January, 1997 allowed the appeal, F. M. A. No. 225 of 1996, in part and modified the ad-interim order passed by the trial Court to the effect that "the students named in paragraph 2 and 3 of the supplementary affidavit as aforesaid shall be allowed to pay the old fees" and that fees at the enhanced rate may be realised from the new students at the time of their admission to the School. It was observed that the temporary injunction matter as well as the suit be disposed of as quickly as possible.
